vintage: Walk graph 2026-10 · Census 2024 · CM stops 2026-08 · Overture 2026-09-23.1
title: Metro Bus coverage with candidate routes
description: Residents and offices within a 10-minute walk of the current Colombo Metro Bus network and with the three best illustrative candidates added.
notes: Derived by developing-country.org with scripts/build-metro-alternatives.mjs on the same model as the metro coverage tables: 80 m/min walking on the OpenStreetMap foot network (5 min = 400 m, 10 min = 800 m), reached streets buffered 50 m, a 5 m equal-area raster, Census 2024 GN population spread evenly within each division, Overture Maps office listings and OSM schools and hospitals.
The best 3 are the candidates with the most new residents within 10 minutes per route km; the scenario walkshed is the union of the network and their stops, so overlap among them is counted once.
caveats: Coverage-only analysis: no travel demand, origin–destination data, road capacity, bus operations, terminal space or cost is considered.
Population is spread evenly within each GN division; residents only, no workplace or daytime population; offices are listings, not jobs.
OSM street and path completeness limits every walkshed; candidate routes follow mapped main roads only.
